'''2009 Match Play Championship Day 1 Matt Carulli LS Mind What You Have Learned''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matt Carulli]] at [[2009 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

* '''Name on sheet:''' Matthew Carulli
* '''Deck name:''' Borma, MWYHL
* '''Username:''' quickdraw3457
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
